name: Interface
description: The default screens built with the toolkit, with the default theme, colours, keymap and controls. So far: two themes, the keymap, the controls of play, the title, new-game, options, pause and load screens, character creation, the play screen with its status column, look mode, the inventory, the condition of a body, the keys of play, the pickers, the prompts for decisions, how the simulation's events are played back, placeholders for the other screens, and a gallery of every widget.
